# LiteRT-LM embedding C API

Unmodified upstream headers from LiteRT-LM v0.18.0, commit
`b2f686e2ed4718fb84ec398a61dd59ca0f0aff27`.
Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/tree/b2f686e2ed4718fb84ec398a61dd59ca0f0aff27/c

The upstream Apache-2.0 license and notices are retained. These declarations are
separate from the qualified v0.17.1 chat/tensor surface; updating one does not
silently update the other. The maintainer generator verifies all three header
digests with `--embedding-engine`, including `--check` support.
